_meta.memberships_note: REAL 2026 dues (Diana's '2026 Annual Membership Dues' sheet, sent by Felicia Aug 3 2026). Dues are set by employee count; every NEW business member also pays a ONE-TIME $50 activation fee, so `amount` (what join-page checkout charges) = dues + activation. `dues`/`activation` exist so pages can show the honest breakdown; min/maxEmployees drive the join page's count→price lookup (maxEmployees null = no upper bound). Non-profit 1-50 employees = $250 flat with IRS determination letter (Diana + Felicia, Aug 3 2026 11am: the sheet's $100 was the OLD cost — never revert to it; Diana quoted the single figure with no activation pair, so no $50 is added); over 50 employees the general schedule applies. RENEWALS never come through here — the pay portal uses /api/pay-items — so the activation fee stays first-year-only.
_meta.source: 2026 Annual Membership Dues sheet (Diana via Felicia, Aug 3 2026). Donation presets are amounts actually received in legacy transaction history (2018–2026).
